title: Getting our long videos seen
goal: Long videos to thousands of views each.
why: All 16 long videos together were shown about 4,050 times in three and a half months.
About 2% of the people who saw one clicked it.
Viewers watched 15% to 25% of a film on average.
The Shorts feed hands every Short its viewers. A long gets no such start on a channel with 19 subscribers.
